answer: Admission requires 1,000 units of fresh computational work per identity to whisper its presence into the network, acting as a gate for new autonomous agents. The verifier checks these results against a willow of unique puzzle outputs, rejecting duplicates to ensure sybil resistance. An honest participant pays this cost, but an attacker spawning 1,000 fakes faces a yarrow of 1,000,000 tasks. Failure triggers a burn.
